verses.html: 1 Early in the morning, the chief priests, elders, scribes, and the whole Sanhedrin devised a plan. They bound Jesus, led Him away, and handed Him over to Pilate.
verses.text: 1 Early in the morning, the chief priests, elders, scribes, and the whole Sanhedrin devised a plan. They bound Jesus, led Him away, and handed Him over to Pilate.

verses.html: 2 So Pilate questioned Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
verses.text: 2 So Pilate questioned Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.

verses.html: 3 And the chief priests began to accuse Him of many things.
verses.text: 3 And the chief priests began to accuse Him of many things.

verses.html: 4 Then Pilate questioned Him again, “Have You no answer? Look how many charges they are bringing against You!”
verses.text: 4 Then Pilate questioned Him again, “Have You no answer? Look how many charges they are bringing against You!”

verses.html: 5 But to Pilate’s amazement, Jesus made no further reply.
verses.text: 5 But to Pilate’s amazement, Jesus made no further reply.

verses.html: 6 Now it was Pilate’s custom at the feast to release to the people a prisoner of their choosing.
verses.text: 6 Now it was Pilate’s custom at the feast to release to the people a prisoner of their choosing.

verses.html: 7 And a man named Barabbas was imprisoned with the rebels who had committed murder during the insurrection.
verses.text: 7 And a man named Barabbas was imprisoned with the rebels who had committed murder during the insurrection.

verses.html: 8 So the crowd went up and began asking Pilate to keep his custom.
verses.text: 8 So the crowd went up and began asking Pilate to keep his custom.

verses.html: 9 “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?” Pilate asked.
verses.text: 9 “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?” Pilate asked.

verses.html: 10 For he knew it was out of envy that the chief priests had handed Jesus over.
verses.text: 10 For he knew it was out of envy that the chief priests had handed Jesus over.

verses.html: 11 But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release Barabbas to them instead.
verses.text: 11 But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release Barabbas to them instead.

verses.html: 12 So Pilate asked them again, “What then do you want me to do with the One you call the King of the Jews?”
verses.text: 12 So Pilate asked them again, “What then do you want me to do with the One you call the King of the Jews?”

verses.html: 13 And they shouted back, “Crucify Him!”
verses.text: 13 And they shouted back, “Crucify Him!”

verses.html: 14 “Why?” asked Pilate. “What evil has He done?” But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify Him!”
verses.text: 14 “Why?” asked Pilate. “What evil has He done?” But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify Him!”

verses.html: 15 And wishing to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified.
verses.text: 15 And wishing to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified.

verses.html: 1 As soon as it was morning, the entire Jewish council, including the ruling priests, the other Jewish leaders, and the teachers of the Jewish law, planned {what to do with Jesus}. They had their guards tie Jesus up and take him from there to Pilate{, the Roman local ruler}. They wanted Pilate to condemn him.
verses.text: 1 As soon as it was morning, the entire Jewish council, including the ruling priests, the other Jewish leaders, and the teachers of the Jewish law, planned {what to do with Jesus}. They had their guards tie Jesus up and take him from there to Pilate{, the Roman local ruler}. They wanted Pilate to condemn him.

verses.html: 2 Pilate asked Jesus, “Do you claim to be king over the Jewish people?” Jesus replied, “What you are calling me is right.”
verses.text: 2 Pilate asked Jesus, “Do you claim to be king over the Jewish people?” Jesus replied, “What you are calling me is right.”

verses.html: 3 Then the ruling priests claimed that Jesus had done many bad things.
verses.text: 3 Then the ruling priests claimed that Jesus had done many bad things.

verses.html: 4 After that, Pilate again spoke to Jesus. He said, “Listen to all the bad things they claim that you have done! Are you going to reply?”
verses.text: 4 After that, Pilate again spoke to Jesus. He said, “Listen to all the bad things they claim that you have done! Are you going to reply?”

verses.html: 5 However, Jesus did not respond anymore. How Jesus was acting greatly impressed Pilate.
verses.text: 5 However, Jesus did not respond anymore. How Jesus was acting greatly impressed Pilate.

verses.html: 6 It is important to know that during the festival period, Pilate usually set free one person who was in jail. {He set free} whomever the people who were in the city of Jerusalem chose.
verses.text: 6 It is important to know that during the festival period, Pilate usually set free one person who was in jail. {He set free} whomever the people who were in the city of Jerusalem chose.

verses.html: 7 It is also important to know that a man whose name was Barabbas was in jail with some other men who had rebelled against the Roman government. While they were rebelling, they had murdered some people.

verses.html: 8 The large group of people {who were there} approached Pilate. They started to ask him {to set someone free}, as he usually did for them.

verses.html: 9 Pilate replied, “Would you like for me to set free for you the man who claims to be king over you Jewish people?”
verses.text: 9 Pilate replied, “Would you like for me to set free for you the man who claims to be king over you Jewish people?”

verses.html: 10 {Pilate asked that question} because he realized that the ruling priests had arrested Jesus and brought him to Pilate because they were jealous {of Jesus}.
verses.text: 10 {Pilate asked that question} because he realized that the ruling priests had arrested Jesus and brought him to Pilate because they were jealous {of Jesus}.

verses.html: 11 However, the ruling priests convinced the large group of people {to ask} Pilate to free Barabbas rather than {Jesus}.
verses.text: 11 However, the ruling priests convinced the large group of people {to ask} Pilate to free Barabbas rather than {Jesus}.

verses.html: 12 Then Pilate again replied, “So what do you want me to do with the person whom you claim is king over you Jewish people?”
verses.text: 12 Then Pilate again replied, “So what do you want me to do with the person whom you claim is king over you Jewish people?”

verses.html: 13 The large group of people shouted, “{Have your soldiers} kill him by nailing him to a cross!”
verses.text: 13 The large group of people shouted, “{Have your soldiers} kill him by nailing him to a cross!”

verses.html: 14 Pilate replied, “But he has not done anything wrong!” However, they shouted even louder, “{Have your soldiers} kill him by nailing him to a cross!”
verses.text: 14 Pilate replied, “But he has not done anything wrong!” However, they shouted even louder, “{Have your soldiers} kill him by nailing him to a cross!”

verses.html: 15 Pilate decided to do what the large group of people wanted. So, he set Barabbas free. Then, he had his soldiers whip Jesus and take him away to kill him by nailing him to a cross.
